name: board_sweep
_comment: U9 wave 8: why some boards never open. Pilot w8_ptr (Kit Ring Crawler: Crawler 100 on a 24 px cyan ring with a white nose spoke; or another w8 pilot for another hulk) at Kit Board Pointer (sÿst 2032), whose only traffic is the Kit Hulk Pointer (immobile 24 px magenta disc with a green nose spoke, derelict gövt 378). loops/board.mjs walks in pressing b at every stop. At the first press the game answers with NOTHING (status line cleared), or within sweep.atPx, it stays at that spot and presses b again and again: 4 presses without moving, then a ~5 degree turn in place before each press, until a dialog opens (closed with Abort: a hulk boards only once) or 70 presses. Every press is shot (sw-NN). Read headings, offsets and answers with analysis/pointer.mjs --run <dir>.
